question: Can the Jacobi-exact (|L|^2, 2T) polhode-identity filter rescue the s055d cascade pool above the 3x operational enrichment gate?
hypothesis: Replacing the scalar pol_diam filter with the joint (|L|^2, 2T) Jacobi filter lifts enrichment above the operational gate.
narrative_md: ORACLE upper-bound retest: replacing s055d's scalar pol_diam filter with the joint (|L|^2, 2T) Jacobi-exact filter gives only 2.13x enrichment at the 10% tube -- still below the 3x operational gate. The cause is upstream and structural: the 30 truth-q_a cascade candidates span ~2 orders of magnitude in polhode-invariant space (|L|^2 in [4.5%, 3.95x] of truth) because the per-pair finite-diff omega-derivation has 100x magnitude scatter even on near-truth pairs. No post-filter can rescue it -- the omega-derivation must be replaced (validates the s061/s062 reframe: omega as INPUT). Uses oracle truth-q_a labels (oracle-leak by design).
